record.oneLiner: Bot API for building bots that send and receive Telegram messages over HTTPS, authenticated with a bot token from @BotFather.
record.verdictReason: A free bot token is created self-serve through @BotFather and the Bot API covers messages, updates, chats and settings. Only community MCP servers exist, which Composio could replace with its own toolkit.

evidence.quote: Each bot is given a unique authentication token when it is created.
The Telegram Bot Platform hosts more than 10 million bots and is free for both users and developers.
The Bot API is an HTTP-based interface created for developers keen on building bots for Telegram.
Production-ready MCP server for the complete Telegram Bot API.
